name: missing_pytest_plugin
description: Tests pass locally where pytest-mock is installed, but CI installs only the top-level requirements and the plugin is missing, so collection fails with ModuleNotFoundError. A classic 'forgot to add it to requirements' drift.
source: https://pytest-mock.readthedocs.io/ (representative of the common missing-test-dependency failure)
